title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
title_zh: 探索权重空间编程：能力、泛化与局限

paragraphs.en: 系统研究权重空间编程，局部参数干预可显著提升性能但可靠性与泛化仍受限。 Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. Homepage: https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub: https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project
paragraphs.zh: 系统研究权重空间编程，局部参数干预可显著提升性能但可靠性与泛化仍受限。权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming, WSP）使推理智能体能够直接检查和修改神经网络参数，为基于梯度的模型适配提供了一种替代方案。 然而，其能力、跨任务泛化以及实际局限仍缺乏充分理解。 我们通过七项基准和两个模型规模（Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 Qwen3.5-9B）上的 16 条编辑轨迹，对 WSP 进行了系统性研究。 我们的发现揭示了三个关键洞见。 首先，WSP 可以通过高度局部化的干预实现显著的性能提升。 在全部保留集评测中，MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 的准确率分别提升最多 29.45、4.42、36.72 和 17.11 个百分点。 值得注意的是，仅修改 1,023 个参数即可带来 29.45 点的提升。 其次，WSP 展现出有前景但不均衡的跨任务泛化能力。 一个经过数学编辑的检查点无需进一步编辑即可将 GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 分别提升 3.03、12.18 和 20.10 点，同时 SciCode 性能保持不变。 第三，有效编辑仍然具有挑战性且不稳定。 不同轨迹之间的结果差异显著，并且当候选改进无法被可靠验证时，16 条轨迹中有 6 条保留了原始权重。 总而言之，这些结果凸显了 WSP 在高度局部化模型适配方面的潜力，同时揭示了在干预发现、可靠性和跨任务迁移方面的重要挑战。 主页：https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub：https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project
